results.title: Udinese Beats Barcelona, Forest In Triangular Preseason Tournament
results.description: Udinese defeated both Barcelona and Nottingham Forest on Saturday to win the inaugural Friuli Venezia Giulia Cup, a triangular preseason tournament held at Bluenergy Stadium in Udine, Italy. Vakoun Issouf Bayo scored a last-minute winner as the hosts beat Barcelona 1-0, after both teams had earlier defeated Forest by the same scoreline. The tournament followed an unusual format, with three consecutive 45-minute matches played in a round-robin structure. Udinese opened the day with a 1-0 win over Forest, with defender Oumar Solet heading home the only goal in the 28th minute off a corner kick. The second match between Barcelona and Forest proved more entertaining, ultimately decided by a stoppage-time Raphinha penalty after Nikola Milenkovic was called for handball. Forest created several chances of their own, with Morgan Gibbs-White striking the woodwork, Dan Ndoye denied by Wojciech Szczesny, and Igor Jesus heading narrowly wide. Barcelona also had opportunities, including a post from young forward Brian Farinas and a save by Matz Sels to deny Hamza Abdelkarim. That result set up a decisive matchup between Udinese and Barcelona. Playing without its eight World Cup-winning Spain internationals, along with Jules Kounde and Anthony Gordon, Barcelona controlled possession for much of the match, with 16-year-old Ebrima Tunkara showing composure on the ball, though the team struggled to create clear scoring chances. Udinese started strongly, faded in the middle portion of the match, then struck late on the counterattack, with Bayo finishing calmly over Szczesny in the final minute to secure the title. Udinese returns to competitive action next weekend against Padova in the Coppa Italia. Barcelona will play Basel in Switzerland before hosting Egyptian club Al Ahly in the Joan Gamper Trophy on Aug. 19. Forest has additional friendlies remaining against Bayer Leverkusen and Brest ahead of its Premier League opener against Leeds United later this month.
